## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete user/evidence problem and what this changes.

## Contract and scope

Capability-ledger rows, evidence categories, supported/unsupported cases, and public interface effects.

## Evidence

Executed checks with exact package/native/runtime identities; independent fixtures and failure/mutation cases. Separate unrun checks and limitations. For optimizations include the profile, hypothesis, whole-workflow measurements and cost/tradeoffs.

## Review and operation

Identify any evaluator-policy, native boundary, source disclosure, UI access, dependency or release-policy changes that need independent ownership. Explain recovery or rollback implications where relevant.
